annotations.title: List what changed since a date

description: Use this when the user (or an app) asks what changed at the banks since a date: fee or term changes, changes a bank has announced for a future date, and welcome offers that started or ended. One call covers every bank in coverage. since (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days back) is required. Each row carries the change only (before and after value, date and whether the bank stated it); for a product's full terms use get_product_terms, for an offer's conditions list_offers. BLIA's own corrections are not listed; a term with no earlier record is a first record, counted in first_records_not_listed; a change BLIA recorded after its date may fall before your window, so poll with overlapping windows. include=["summary"] adds one plain sentence per row (describes only; never advice). Open preview: see preview.ends.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a prior call with the same window

include.description: include=["summary"] adds to each row one sentence written by BLIA's code from the same logic as its rule summaries (summary_source generated_from_logic): before and after, and the date as the bank stated it or as BLIA first recorded it. Without it the rows are unchanged.

institution.description: Institution id as listed in coverage.institutions_covered (bmo, cibc, rbc, scotia, td: the Big 5); a common or legal name such as BMO, RBC, Scotiabank or Royal Bank of Canada also resolves. Omit for all.

kinds.description: Which kinds of change to list. Omit for all four.

product_class.description: Product class. Only "chequing" is covered today.

since.description: Required. YYYY-MM-DD, at most 90 days back: changes dated on or after it.

name: list_changes

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

attribution.description: The attribution line to show wherever these values are displayed to a user (bliahub.com terms).

coverage.description: What BLIA does and does not cover: product classes, institutions, kinds of information.

coverage_scope.description: The product class, institutions and lineup completeness the snapshot covers.

disclaimer.description: BLIA's disclaimer, verbatim. Include it when relaying values.

as_of.description: When the snapshot was built, ISO 8601 UTC.

guidance.description: What to say and what to confirm with the institution at this age.

status.description: How old the snapshot is: current up to 30 days, aging up to 90, then stale.

freshness_warning.description: Repeats freshness.guidance when the snapshot is not current.

publication_seq.description: Publication number of the snapshot being served.
